text:
Emily: Quick kickoff — sharing the Week‑Zero 'Ignite' plan for the launch newsletter. Trying a segmented rollout by persona (startup / platform / enterprise) with staggered warmup sends. Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/ignite-week0 (please comment)
Raj: love the persona split. can we keep send windows PST morning for startup, CET afternoons for enterprise?
Olivia: yes on windows. would add a micro‑segment for 'trial-users > 7d && active' — higher priority for demo invites.
Ben: FYI: list sizes today — startup 8.7k, platform 4.1k, enterprise 1.9k. expect ~12k total across segments.
Marc: A/B test idea: Subject A = "See Redwood Inference in action — launch invite" vs Subject B = "Benchmark: cut inference cost by 30%" — which persona gets which?
Taylor: For startup: use 'See Redwood Inference in action' (more product-first). Enterprise gets the benchmark CTA. platform gets a hybrid.
Emily: good. we'll run 50/50 tests within each persona. tracking tags: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=ignite_week0&utm_medium=email. please add param campaign_id=ignite_w0_v1
Olivia: automation notes — suppress if emailed within last 7 days, exclude unsubscribed. If enterprise lead opens but doesn't click, trigger followup email at +48h with case study.
Ben: can ops send the CSV export of enterprise segment? I need to wire to HubSpot sync.
Marc: attached quick filter for the enterprise segment (paste into Mailer):
```
segment = users
where company_size in (200, 500, 1000+)
and role in (Engineering, ML)
and last_active > "2026-01-01"
```
Taylor: Webinar integration: when someone clicks register in the email, fire webhook to Zoom + tag in CRM = "ignite_w0_reg" — @Ben can you confirm webhook path?
Ben: Confirmed — webhook endpoint /api/integrations/zoom/ignite_w0. Also I'll set up SDR queue: anyone who registers + asks pricing -> ticket to SDRs.
Emily: Creative asks: 1) two hero images (startup vs enterprise) 2) 3 alt subject lines for backup 3) short one‑liner for CTA. Need by EOD tomorrow.
Raj: I'll loop in design. For hero image idea: abstract GPU rack for enterprise, product screenshot for startup.
Olivia: small copy tweak: change CTA copy to "See live demo" for startup, "View benchmark" for enterprise.
Marc: metric targets: open 25% startup, 22% platform, 18% enterprise. CTR targets: 3.0% startup, 2.5% platform, 2.2% enterprise. Let's monitor first 6 hours.
Taylor: Also recommend a stagger: send startup on Monday 10am PST, platform Monday 1pm PST, enterprise Tuesday 10am CET — reduces pressure on support.
Emily: timeline: final assets by tomorrow EOD, build & test Wed, send windows Mon/Tue. Please flag blockers by COB today.
AnnounceBot: Calendar event created: "Ignite Week0 launch — final review" Thu 09:00 PT — attendees: Emily, Raj, Olivia, Ben, Marc, Taylor
Ben: noted — will upload segment CSV to the shared folder after my sync at 3pm.
Raj: small ask — can we add a second‑chance resend for non‑openers at +72h with modified subject? keeps cadence light.
Emily: yes, plan +72h second chance with new subject line and different preheader. I'll draft the copy after design assets land. :thumbsup:
Olivia: added a checklist to the Notion page — tagging folks for each item.
Marc: cool — I'll watch the dashboards and postfirst-hour metrics in #marketing once live.
Emily: great team — thanks. last call: anyone see deliverability risk with the combined send volumes?
Ben: deliverability looks clean. we'll throttle via platform if we see spikes.
Emily: perfect. closing loop — we'll reconvene Fri if anything shifts.
